subject: NSObject

observation.summary: A runtime probe compiled with clang against the Foundation framework header enumerates the class-hierarchy parent of NSObject by calling objc_getClass("NSObject"), class_getSuperclass(), class_copyMethodList(), and class_copyMethodList(object_getClass(...)). NSObject resolves at runtime; its superclass pointer is NULL (root class). NSString, NSMutableString, NSArray, NSMutableArray, NSDictionary, NSMutableDictionary, NSNumber, NSValue, NSDate, NSURL, NSError, NSUUID, NSAutoreleasePool, NSRunLoop, NSKeyedArchiver, NSKeyedUnarchiver, and NSCoder are all observed as live ObjC runtime classes — every one reports NSObject as its superclass chain root.

claim: NSObject is the root class of the Foundation Objective-C hierarchy on this host and is the superclass (directly or transitively) of NSString, NSMutableString, NSArray, NSMutableArray, NSDictionary, NSMutableDictionary, NSNumber (via NSValue), NSValue, NSDate, NSURL, NSError, NSUUID, NSAutoreleasePool, NSRunLoop, NSCoder, NSKeyedArchiver, and NSKeyedUnarchiver.
